key_insight: A PPO-based controller can coordinate battery, hydrogen, diesel, and grid exchange in a community microgrid to deliver high renewable utilization and reliable supply under uncertainty.
engineering_relevance: The study shows how reinforcement learning can improve dispatch decisions for hybrid energy systems, supporting practical microgrid design for resilience, cost, and emissions reduction.
method: Formulated microgrid EMS as an 11-dimensional Markov decision process.
Used proximal policy optimization with three continuous actions for battery, diesel, and hydrogen dispatch.
Evaluated grid-connected operation with PV, wind, battery, electrolyzer, hydrogen storage, fuel cell, and diesel backup.
evidence_signal: The policy was tested on 8,760 hourly observations for a 1,000-household community and achieved A$195,690.67 annual revenue, 91.2% renewable fraction, and 99.77% load satisfaction in the normal case.
watch_item: Performance is sensitive to renewable variability, training stability, and the accounting boundary used for carbon and reliability metrics.
paper_title: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Energy Management for Hydrogen-Enabled Community Microgrids Under Uncertainty
